source_material.description: KESPA v7.0-v7.3 feature/Jira summary supplied by the project owner on 2026-09-28.

directly_recorded_facts: The session release range was v7.0 through v7.3, with v7.3 the final iteration.
The image work was completed in v7.0.
A private image-edit request could fail with image_edit_private_route_unavailable when no provider was authorized to receive private image data.
A first-class image_edit capability was added.
The KESPA Local Image Bridge was explicitly trusted for the image-edit path.
Raw internal errors were prevented from leaking to users.
The control plane remained Admin / brain_config / provider routing database.
No Brain runtime modification was required for this work.
The issue status was Implemented / Pending Production Validation.
validation_boundary: Production validation remained pending in the supplied source.
No image-edit quality, segmentation quality, latency, throughput, or reliability benchmark was supplied.
No complete production-tested provider-fallback matrix was supplied.
The source does not establish that every external provider is eligible to receive private image data.
Deterministic transparent-background processing is one transformation path and is not evidence of general deterministic image editing.

deduplication.distinct_scope: KESPA-NOTE-028 covers generation of new images and generated-image retention/storage. This release covers editing an existing/private image, private-data route eligibility, deterministic transformation handling, fallback, edit lineage/provenance, and safe error behavior.

publication_exclusions: credentials, API keys, bearer tokens, cookies, or sessions
raw internal error bodies and stack traces
unsupported claims of production validation or image-edit quality
